chunks: Ahmad b. Ziyad al-Hamadani (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us, from 'Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim, from Muhammad b. 'Isa b. 'Ubayd, from Muhammad b. Sulayman al-Basri, from his father, from Ibrahim b. Abi Hajar al-Aslami, from Qubaysa, from Jabir b. Yazid al-Ju'fi, who said: I heard the Deputy of Deputies, the Inheritor of the Prophets' knowledge, Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. 'Ali b. al-Husayn b. 'Ali b. Abi Talib saying: The Master of Worshippers 'Ali b. al-Husayn narrated to me, from the Master of Martyrs al-Husayn b. 'Ali b. Abi Talib, from the Master of Deputies, the Commander of the Faithful 'Ali b. Abi Talib (peace be upon them all), who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:
A part of me will be buried in Khurasan. No afflicted person will visit it except that Allah will ease his affliction, and no sinner except that Allah will forgive his sins.

key_terms.بضعة مني: A part of me — referring to Imam al-Rida as part of the Prophet
key_terms.زيارة: Visitation (ziyara) — pilgrimage to an Imam's shrine
key_terms.عارفاً بحقه: Recognizing his right — acknowledging his divinely appointed Imamate

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about visiting the shrine in Khurasan?
ai.summary: Through an extraordinary chain of golden narrators passing through four Imams (al-Baqir from Zayn al-Abidin from al-Husayn from Imam Ali), the Prophet Muhammad (S) himself said: 'A part of me will be buried in Khurasan. No afflicted person will visit it except that Allah will ease his affliction, and no sinner except that Allah will forgive his sins.' This is one of the most powerful hadiths about the shrine of Imam al-Rida, as it originates directly from the Prophet through four successive Imams.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Ziyad al-Hamadani (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Isa b. `Ubayd narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Sulayman al-Basri narrated to us from his father from Ibrahim b. Abi Hajar al-Aslami. He said: Qubaysa narrated to us from Jabir b. Yazid al-Ju`fi. He said: I heard the Deputy of Deputies and the Inheritor of the Knowledge of the Prophets Aba Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. `Ali b. Abi Talib say: The Master of Worshipers `Ali b. al-Husayn narrated to me from the Master of Martyrs al-Husayn b. `Ali b. Abi Talib from the Master of Deputies Amir al-Mu’minin `Ali b.

Abi Talib (as): The Messenger of Allah (s) said: A part of me will be buried in Khurasan. No afflicted person will visit it except that Allah will ease his affliction, and no sinner except that Allah forgives his sins.
